dogecoin.text:
@LodocArt Every time I’ve heard podcasters or other folks say the doge part of dogecoin, I’ve heard them say /doʊʒ/ (dohj). I think it should be /doʊg/ (dohg), since it’s supposed to be a dumb/cute way of pronouncing “dog”. 

I’m thinking way too hard about this 💀

My pettiest take about cryptocurrency: I *hate* that the accepted pronunciation of Dogecoin has become “dojecoin”. It should be a hard G. The soft G makes about as much sense to me as... well, cryptocurrency.
